card.name: Prepositions after a completed clause
card.fires_on: Short prepositions such as by, at, in, via and through that come right after a full clause and begin a phrase giving the route, setting, dose level or location. Mostly in drug-label text, sometimes in general prose.

modes.label: Route or dose qualifier
modes.description: A preposition after a dosing statement that introduces the route, dose level or condition.
modes.example: The maximum total dosage<< by>> I.V. injection is 2 mg

modes.label: Setting or condition
modes.description: A preposition after a verb phrase that introduces a state, place or time frame.
